tools.name: list_signature_tours
tools.title: List Signature tours
tools.description: List the published Signature tour catalog (id, title, region, duration, theme, from-price in EUR, and short blurb). Public catalog data — safe to read without side effects.

region.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter by region (e.g. 'Sintra', 'Alentejo', 'Arrábida').

theme.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter by theme (e.g. 'Wine', 'Culture').

tools.name: list_my_bookings
tools.title: List my bookings
tools.description: List bookings for the signed-in user (matched by verified email). Returns id, tour, date, guests, status, amount and currency. RLS restricts results to the caller's own bookings.

limit.description: Maximum number of bookings to return (default 20).

tools.name: get_my_booking
tools.title: Get one of my bookings
tools.description: Get the full details of one of the signed-in user's bookings by id. RLS ensures only the caller's own bookings are returned.
